newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares firm, headed for correction.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares firm, headed for correction.

text.p: Slovenia's blue-chip SBI index firmed 0.59 percent on Friday but traders said they expected the market to trade with a downward bias next week as the time was ripe for a correction.
The index has gained 19.4 percent since June 27 when the Bank of Slovenia eased foreign investment rules.
"I expect the correction could push the index down to 1,440 or 1,450 points," one said.
* The SBI index rose 8.74 points to 1,478.21.
* Drug firm Lek had the highest turnover and kept steady at 34,600 tolars on volume of 8,230 shares for total turnover of 286.3 million tolars. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
